items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, Frank Isola and Taylor LaFarge had been playing with me at the 34th Street loft. We had gone over the Back Country Suite there. So I used them to make the record later.

ctx.x: Did you meet any of the people you‘d subsequently on that first trip to New York?
No. Not at the moment. I met them... I met Frank Isola at the 34th Street loft. We used to go there and play.
This is when you moved to New York for good.
